zh: 计划审批显示计划标题，并可直接打开完整计划。
提问弹窗显示 Agent 提问前的说明，支持展开和复制；单选答案的选中状态更清晰。
任务卡片上的错误提示可以关闭；从父任务卡片打开子任务后，可以返回父任务。
手机看板会恢复泳道的滚动位置，并优化滚动加载和泳道切换。
改进问题选项和审批按钮的布局，适配窄屏与较大字号；状态图标随字号缩放。
新增可选设置，将包含 `ui` 或 `app` 代码块的回复交给 genui 等插件渲染，默认关闭。
更新中英文 README，并补充独立的安装、限制、性能和排错文档。
en: Plan approvals show a title and let you open the full plan.
Question dialogs show the agent’s preceding note, with options to expand and copy it. Selected answers are easier to identify.
Dismiss errors on task cards, and return to a parent task after opening a subtask from its card.
The phone board restores lane scroll positions and improves scroll loading and lane switching.
Question choices and approval buttons fit better on narrow screens and with larger text. Status icons scale with text size.
An optional setting hands replies containing `ui` or `app` code blocks to genui or another renderer. It is off by default.
Refreshed the English and Chinese READMEs and added dedicated installation, limitations, performance, and troubleshooting guides.
